page: Microsoft Azure D128nds_v6 is an x86_64 virtual machine within the general-purpose Dndv6 family, powered by Intel processors and virtualized via Microsoft Hyper-V. The system provides 128 dedicated vCPUs paired with 512.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB per core. Operating without GPU accelerators, it focuses processing resources on multi-threaded central processing tasks and parallel execution.

Storage and networking subsystems form a prominent part of this instance specification. The configuration includes 7,559 GB of direct-attached local NVMe SSD storage alongside capability for Azure Premium Storage. The local NVMe array offers low-latency, high-throughput temporary storage directly on the host node. In addition, the instance profile includes network optimization enhancements designed to handle high-volume network transfers.

From a resource utilization and cost perspective, the instance provides high density by combining substantial CPU core counts, a standard 1:4 memory allocation, and large local NVMe capacity. Environments that do not require local ephemeral storage or massive thread counts may achieve higher efficiency on smaller sizes, but this profile eliminates storage I/O bottlenecks for heavy node-local operations. It is suited for large relational databases, transactional processing, extract-transform-load (ETL) pipelines, and high-throughput analytics systems.
description: Microsoft Azure D128nds_v6 is a general-purpose, network-optimized virtual machine built on Microsoft Hyper-V and powered by x86_64 Intel processors. The instance delivers 128 dedicated vCPUs and 512.0 GB of RAM, sustaining a balanced 4.0 GB of memory per core. A key hardware component is its 7,559 GB local NVMe SSD storage pool, accompanied by support for Azure Premium Storage, which facilitates rapid I/O operations for disk-heavy processes. The instance does not feature GPU acceleration, directing its capacity toward large-scale multi-core execution and high data throughput. By consolidating high-density compute, substantial memory, and massive local NVMe disk access on a single host, the D128nds_v6 delivers strong resource efficiency for demanding multi-threaded applications. It is tailored for enterprise-scale workloads such as relational database clusters, transactional processing, extract-transform-load (ETL) operations, real-time analytics engines, and large-scale compilation tasks.
